title: Listening Mini Test · Thư viện thành phố

sections.title: Joining the city library
sections.context: Marco đến quầy hỗ trợ của thư viện thành phố để đăng ký thẻ và hỏi về quy định mượn tài liệu.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Good afternoon. Are you waiting to be served, or just sheltering from the rain?

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: A bit of both, honestly. I'd like to join the library, if it isn't too complicated.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Not complicated at all. It takes about five minutes. I'll fill the form in on the screen and you can check it at the end. Your first name?

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Marco. And the surname is Delgado.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Could you spell that for me? I've had Delgardo and Delagado this week already.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Of course. D-E-L-G-A-D-O. Delgado, no R.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Thank you. And your address?

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Flat 6, 28 Kingsley Street. That's K-I-N-G-S-L-E-Y.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Kingsley Street, lovely. Not Kingsway — we have both, and the post gets muddled constantly. A telephone number?

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: My mobile is 07700 918442.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: 07700 918442. And the last thing I need is proof that you live at that address.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Ah. I've got my passport with me, but nothing else.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: The passport proves who you are, which is half of it, but for the address we need something dated in the last three months. A bank statement used to be fine and people still expect it, but head office changed the rules in January. What we want now is a recent electricity bill.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: An electricity bill. I can bring one tomorrow — it came last week.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Perfect. I'll save the form as provisional and print your card once I've seen it. Cards go off to be printed on Fridays, so yours will be ready to collect on 16 May.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: The sixteenth. I'll write that down.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Now, borrowing. You can take up to twelve items at a time. Books are three weeks, and so are audiobooks. DVDs are different, though — they go out for seven days only, because there's a waiting list for most of them.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Seven days for DVDs. And what if I want something the library hasn't got on the shelf?

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Then you reserve it, and we'll bring it in from another branch. There's a charge for that: it's £1.50 per item. It went up from ninety pence in the spring, I'm afraid, but it's still cheaper than buying the book.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: That's fair enough. Can I ask about the study rooms upstairs? A friend told me they're expensive.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Your friend is thinking of the conference room, which businesses hire. The four small study rooms are free for members — you just need your card. They're open all day, not only in the evening, and you book them on the website rather than coming to the desk.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Free. That's better news than I expected. And if I can't finish a book in three weeks?

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: You renew it. You can do it online, up to three times, as long as nobody else has reserved it. After the third renewal you do have to bring it back in, and please don't ring us to renew — we stopped taking renewals by telephone two years ago.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Online, three times. Got it. Is there anything else I ought to know?

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: There's an app for e-books and audiobooks, which you might download eventually, and our local history team on the second floor is excellent if you ever need them. But what I'd really suggest for a new member is the tour. One of the volunteers takes a group round every Saturday at ten, and it lasts half an hour. People always tell me afterwards that they had no idea half of this building existed.

transcript.speaker: Marco
transcript.text: Saturday at ten. I'll come with my electricity bill on my way in.

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Even better — then you can collect the card and do the tour in one trip. See you on Saturday, Mr Delgado.

groups.instruction: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.intro:
CITY LIBRARY — NEW MEMBER FORM

First name: Marco
Surname: ______ (1)
Address: Flat 6, 28 ______ (2) Street
Telephone: ______ (3)
Proof of address: a recent ______ (4) bill
Card ready to collect on: ______ (5)

Borrowing
DVDs may be kept for ______ (6) days
Charge to reserve an item: £______ (7)

questions.explanation: Marco đánh vần: 'D-E-L-G-A-D-O. Delgado, no R.' – các cách viết Delgardo/Delagado là bẫy.
'Flat 6, 28 Kingsley Street. That's K-I-N-G-S-L-E-Y.' Thủ thư nhắc thêm rằng không phải Kingsway.
'My mobile is 07700 918442', và thủ thư nhắc lại đúng số này.

questions.prompt: Loại hóa đơn dùng làm giấy tờ chứng minh địa chỉ
questions.explanation: 'A bank statement used to be fine... What we want now is a recent electricity bill.' Sao kê ngân hàng là quy định cũ.

questions.prompt: Ngày có thể đến lấy thẻ
questions.explanation: 'Cards go off to be printed on Fridays, so yours will be ready to collect on 16 May.'

questions.prompt: Số ngày được mượn đĩa DVD
questions.explanation: 'Books are three weeks... DVDs are different, though — they go out for seven days only.'

questions.prompt: Phí đặt mượn một tài liệu (bảng Anh)
questions.explanation: 'There's a charge for that: it's £1.50 per item. It went up from ninety pence in the spring.'

groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.prompt: What does Nadia say about the small study rooms?
options: They must be booked at the desk.
They are only available in the evening.
questions.explanation: 'The four small study rooms are free for members — you just need your card', và phải đặt chỗ trên website chứ không phải tại quầy.

questions.prompt: How can Marco renew a book?
options: only by returning to the library
questions.explanation: 'You can do it online, up to three times, as long as nobody else has reserved it', và thư viện đã ngừng gia hạn qua điện thoại.

questions.prompt: What does Nadia suggest that Marco does as a new member?
options: speak to the local history team
questions.explanation: 'what I'd really suggest for a new member is the tour. One of the volunteers takes a group round every Saturday at ten.'
